description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to optimizers in the PyTorch library, including optimizer parameters, options, parameter groups, and the base Optimizer class with serialization support.

classes.name: OptimizerParamState
classes.description: Base class for storing optimizer parameter state with serialization support.

classes.name: OptimizerCloneableParamState
classes.description: Template class for cloneable optimizer parameter state.

classes.name: OptimizerOptions
classes.description: Base class for optimizer options with cloning and serialization.

classes.name: OptimizerCloneableOptions
classes.description: Template class for cloneable optimizer options.

classes.name: OptimizerParamGroup
classes.description: Stores a group of parameters and associated options for an optimizer.

classes.name: Optimizer
classes.description: Abstract base class for optimizers, supporting parameter management, state, and serialization.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the optimizer parameter state or options.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the optimizer parameter state or options.

methods.name: has_options
methods.description: Checks if the parameter group has options.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Accesses the options of the parameter group.

methods.name: set_options
methods.description: Sets the options for the parameter group.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Accesses the parameters in the group.

methods.name: add_param_group
methods.description: Adds a parameter group to the optimizer.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros out gradients of all parameters.
